verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a public HTTP API (event ingestion, Pixel API, Event Audit API, Transformations/Libraries management, Audit Logs, usage metrics) explicitly for programmatic management of connections and features, plus SDKs across platforms. This gives AI-native users a documented way to drive the product programmatically, though no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found by probes and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness. Missing for 10: public OpenAPI/swagger schema, third-party/independent validation of API completeness or reliability.
